metadata.coverage: 380 completed Premier League fixtures from the 2023/24 season; every played date and final score cross-checked against football-data.co.uk. Original matchweek labels are retained for rearranged fixtures.

metricDefinitions.Points: Three points per win and one per draw; final standings include Everton -8 and Nottingham Forest -4 as documented in the Premier League handbook. Home/away splits remain match-earned points.
metricDefinitions.Points trend: Cumulative match-earned points by original fixture matchweek, before disciplinary deductions. Rearranged games are grouped with their original matchweek; this is not a historical calendar-date table.
metricDefinitions.Form: Last five completed results in actual played-date order, oldest to newest.
metricDefinitions.Win percentage: Wins divided by played matches, multiplied by 100.
metricDefinitions.Kickoff time: openfootball local UK kickoff converted to UTC using Europe/London historical offsets. Arsenal–Forest on 12 August uses the delayed 13:00 BST start.
metricDefinitions.Source scope: Final scores, dates, teams and source matchweeks only. No expected goals, possession, player statistics or other advanced metrics are inferred.
